news.title: Detecting signs of hypertension using wearable sensors
GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
news.body: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

news.title: OpenAI 公布计算园区社区承诺与政策建议
news.body: 公司发布社区公约和计算园区政策蓝图，涉及当地参与、电力成本及就业机会。承诺主要面向未来自有运营园区，实施进度仍需后续核验。
news.title_original: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
news.body_original: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

news.title: MIT 用多视角不确定性分析修正机器人记忆
news.body: UQ-DAAAM 比较同一物体的多种描述，识别可能误标的记忆，并选择额外视角改善描述。研究面向复杂机器人任务，实际部署效果仍需验证。
news.title_original: Clearing up a robot’s fuzzy memory
news.body_original: A new system identifies and corrects unreliable object descriptions stored in a robot’s memory, improving the robot’s ability to interact with its environment.

news.title: Phonon 介绍端侧语音合成与开放权重
news.body: 文章介绍可离线运行的小型语音模型及语音定制能力。31m 版本采用 Apache 2.0，其他模型使用非商业许可，应用时需按版本核查授权与硬件条件。
news.title_original: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.

news.title: Google 以交互讨论澄清主观图像分类边界
news.body: Agile Deliberation 引导用户划分子类并讨论边界案例，再用大模型驱动的优化流程构建分类器。类别定义依赖文化、个人偏好和使用情境。
news.title_original: Agile Deliberation: How AI helps humans define the gray areas

news.title: Dharma 发布文档结构化字段抽取模型
news.body: 文章介绍约 20 亿参数模型，按用户指定字段将文档信息转为 JSON。性能比较来自发布方所测任务，跨文档类型与实际业务准确性仍需评估。
news.title_original: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out

news.title: OpenAI 宣布拟收购 Pierre Computer Company
news.body: 公告计划引入 Pierre 团队和开发工具经验，扩展 Codex 的代码浏览、审查与 Git 工作流。交易公告描述拟议收购，交割状态应以后续信息为准。
news.title_original: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
news.body_original: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

news.title: OpenAI 披露 Linux 漏洞发现与补丁生成流程
news.body: 报告称一次运行验证并为 948 个本地提权漏洞生成补丁，API 成本约 120 万美元。数字来自该次研究运行，补丁的维护者审核和实际合入需要分别确认。
news.title_original: A thousand fewer paths to root
news.body_original: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

news.title: Daybreak Red 扩展至 AWS GovCloud 美国东区
news.body: 公告向获批客户提供 GPT-5.6 Cyber，用于授权漏洞研究、受控复现与安全测试。使用资格与部署治理要求仍适用，修复方案需由专业人员审核。
news.title_original: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
news.body_original: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

news.title: OpenAI 发布 Images 2.6 图像生成与编辑更新
news.body: 更新面向 ChatGPT、Codex 和 API，介绍更快生成、多轮一致性编辑及 GIF 功能。API 提供不同速度和质量选项，实际表现依赖所选设置。
news.body_original: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

news.title: DevRev 分享企业自助服务智能体实践
news.body: 案例介绍结合企业知识、实时数据和模型，让 Computer 与 Operator 处理客户及员工请求。案例成效来自企业介绍，实际操作仍受组织权限和审核流程约束。
news.title_original: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
news.body_original: DevRev uses GPT-6.1 Sol to power Computer and Operator, balancing reasoning, speed, and cost for enterprise service.

news.title: StateBench 评估长文档中的状态追踪
news.body: 基准区分查找最近一次更新与追踪多步状态变化，测试模型能否持续跟踪实体和对象。结果取决于基准任务设置。
news.title_original: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents

news.title: IBM 用小模型生成符合模板的演示文稿
news.body: Palette 用按设计规范生成的合成数据训练开放权重模型，并以自动检查发现文字溢出和元素重叠等问题。效果取决于模板和训练数据。
news.title_original: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language

news.title: MIT.nano 会议讨论如何连接共享科研设施
news.body: 报道回顾 10 月 NEMO 用户会议。与会者讨论仪器预约、访问权限和培训，以及如何跨机构找到所需设备。
news.title_original: Building connections across the research infrastructure
news.body_original: MIT.nano and the Northeast Microelectronics Coalition gathered facility leaders and technology professionals from across the nation to explore ways to make shared-access facilities more connected.

papers.body: arXiv:2611.05946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIP), particularly the foundational models for materials chemistry, such as MACE, has significantly strengthened our capabilities in studying the complex dynamics of materials through statistical sampling. Here, by performing molecular dynamics with a fine-tuned MACE model, that are further combined with essential dynamics analysis, a tool that is commonly applied in (bio)molecular simulations, we examine the temperature-dependent ion dynamics in a prototypical inorganic solid superionic conductor, namely argyrodite Li$_{6}$PS$_{5}$Cl.
